papers.title: MMFFNet: Multimodal Feature Fusion Network for RGB-T Crowd Counting
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
papers.paper_type: Computer Vision / Multimodal Fusion / RGB-T Crowd Counting method paper
papers.abstract: MMFFNet proposes an encoder-fusion-decoder multimodal feature fusion network for RGB-T crowd counting. It uses a feature fusion module to fuse multi-level RGB and thermal features and a feature decoding module based on attention mechanisms to improve density map estimation while balancing accuracy and computational cost.
